description: Deadwood of the North Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold. Requirements: - Deadwood Den Watcher x 6 - Deadwood Avenger x 6 - Deadwood Shaman x 6
name: Deadwood of the North
